ctx.x: We just touched on it, but didn't really talk much about it.

Well, I mean, he was working in the club, the Club Alabam, I think it was called -- him and Lannie Scott. Remember Lannie Scott? That was the weirdest thing. As long as Lannie Scott... See, Art had a room where he played when he was younger called the Blue Room, you know, and Lannie worked with Hardnott's(?) band. He had the band that played on Saturday. As long as Art was there, Lannie played marvelous. Man, he had a real thing with Art, you know -- up to a point. As soon as Art went away, then he didn't sound…
